blocks.content: All public servants must declare their assets and liabilities, including those of their spouses and dependent children.
All public servants must declare their assets and liabilities, including those of their spouses and dependent children.

items: Exams often test family inclusion: Disclosure is mandatory for both spouse AND dependent children.
Pay attention to the scope: It requires declaring BOTH assets and liabilities, not just income/assets.
Remember that the rule applies universally to 'all' public servants.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Mandatory declaration of financial holdings applies to all public servants.
The disclosure encompasses both assets and liabilities.
Financial disclosures must extend to the public servant's spouse.
Dependent children's assets and liabilities must also be fully declared.
